# Time Tracker: free billable hours, then an invoice

> Free time tracker for freelancers and contractors: start a timer or add hours by hand, set a rate per project, round up the way you bill, see unbilled money by client, and turn tracked hours into an Invoice Maker draft. No account, no limit, works offline.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
